why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Download the MinionLab app Pick the version for your device. The homepage lists Chrome Web Store, Google Play, Windows and Mac downloads, and the Download Now page is linked from its header. The project notes the app is not yet digitally signed, so some antivirus tools may flag it.
2 Step 2 : Sign up for an account Register or log in on the Register / Log In page after installing the app.
3 Step 3 : Authorize your Minion Give the Minion access to the device's idle resources, which also sets up its digital identity.
4 Step 4 : Keep the Minion online Leave the app running so the Minion can take quests.
5 Step 5 : Follow project updates Check the TGE announcement and the MinionLab X account for news on the token.
